questions.stem: You are an Ob/gyn and your daughter who has recently entered puberty comes to you with a concern. She has been experiencing mid-cycle pain before she gets her regular periods. The most probable etiology is:
questions.solutionHtml:
Mittelschmerz
  • A female giving history of sharp pain in the lower abdomen, every month, 2 weeks before menstruation suggests Mittelschmerz as the diagnosis. Mittelschmerz is synonymous with painful ovulation. Pain is associated with rupture of ovarian follicle at the time of ovulation In most cases, mittelschmerz doesn't require medical attention.


Shaw’s Textbook of Gynaecology, 17th Edition, Page No. 48

questions.stem: A woman presents to her obstetrician with concerns that she has had trouble breastfeeding. Which of the following hormones is involved in the ejection of milk from a lactating mammary gland?
questions.solutionHtml:
Oxytocin
  • A combined neurogenic and hormonal reflex involving oxytocin, a posterior pituitary hormone, causes the actual ejection (“let-down”) of milk from breast tissue. The secretion of oxytocin is increased by stressful stimuli, and inhibited by alcohol.
  • Furthermore, alcohol is transferred from the mother’s bloodstream into her breast milk and to the nursing infant, where it can have many deleterious effects.


Shaw’s Textbook of Gynaecology, 16th Edition, Page No. 37-44

questions.answerText: FSH acts on granulosa cells and LH on theca cells
questions.solutionHtml:
FSH acts on granulosa cells and LH on theca cells
  • Theca internal cells have many LH receptors, and LH converts cholesterol to androstenedione.
  • The theca interna cells supply androstenedione to the granulosa cells.
  • The granulosa cells make estradiol when provided with androgens, and it appears that the estradiol they form in primates is secreted into the follicular fluid.


Guyton and Hall Textbook of Medical Physiology, 13th Edition, Page No. 1068, 1069

questions.stem: A couple who have been married for 3 years came to OPD for infertility. The sperm analysis of male comes out to be normal. The female gave a history of irregular menstrual cycles. Suspecting anovulation, the doctor called the patient on day 22 of the cycle and a sample was taken from the vagina and uterus for hormonal studies. A USG was done on the same day. what is the normal endometrial thickness that is expected on this day of the cycle?
questions.solutionHtml:
14mm

The USG is done on day 22 of the cycle, which is the secretory phase, and during the secretory phase, the endometrial thickness is expected between 7-16mm. so option d is expected



Shaw’s Textbook of Gynaecology, 17th Edition, Page No. 355

questions.stemHtml: An ovulation workup was done on a female patient presenting with infertility. Match the following accordingly:
questions.solutionHtml:
1=c, 2=e, 3=a, 4=b, 5=d

1) Endometrial biopsy for secretory endometrium- D21-23
2) Vaginal cytology - D12-14 and D21-23
3) Serum progesterone - d 21
4) Serum LH – mid-cycle daily ( D12-14 )
5) Urinary LH for LH Surge - D12-14

  • Ovulation assessment- by BBT is done throughout the cycle and shows a biphasic pattern
  • Secretory endometrium is assessed by endometrial biopsy on D21-23
  • Vaginal cytology- D 12-14 D 21-23
    Discrete cells Folded edges.
    Pyknotic nuclei In clumps
    Background clear background dirty
  • Serum progesterone is assessed from D8-21 ( D8 values < 1ng/ml and D -21 > 6ng/ml)
  • Serum LH is assessed daily from D12 to 14... Ovulation occurs about 10-12hrs after LH Surge
  • Urinary LH on Days 12-14 to look for LH Surge. The follicular measurement approaches around 20mm.


DC Dutta's Textbook of Gynecology, 7th Edition, Page No. 240

options.label: B
options.text: A groove between labia minora and hymen

questions.answerText: A groove between labia minora and hymen
questions.solutionHtml:
A groove between labia minora and hymen
  • Bartholin’s glands ( greater vestibular glands) are pea-sized oval glands in females that are homologous to the bulb of the penis in males.
  • The ducts of the Bartholin gland are 2 cm long and open into the vestibule outside the hymen at the junction of the anterior 2/3rd and posterior 1/3rd in the groove between the hymen and labium minora.
  • The duct as well gland is lined by multi-layered columnar epithelium. But near its opening by stratified squamous epithelium (Not by transitional epithelium as is usually stated).
  • The function of the gland is to produce abundant alkaline mucus during sexual excitement.


DC Dutta's Textbook of Gynecology, 8th Edition, Page No. 2, 3

questions.stem: Which of the following modalities has shown the best result for premenstrual syndrome?
questions.solutionHtml:
SSRI

Premenstrual disorders:

  • Frequently women of reproductive age experience symptoms during the late luteal phase of their menstrual cycle, and collectively these complaints are termed premenstrual syndrome (PMS) or premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD). It is mostly seen in women aged 30–45 years
  • Choice of treatment in PMS
  • Amongst all the drugs used-SSRI's have shown the best results. Women who meet strict criteria for diagnosis of PMS or PMDD, including socioeconomic dysfunction, are candidates for treatment with an SSRI (fluoxetine, sertraline, paroxetine, velnafexine), administered daily or only during the luteal phase. Progesterone, Estrogen & Anxiolytics can all be given but as a second line.


DC Dutta's Textbook of Gynecology, 6th Edition, Page No. 48
